how.title: Add a hook
how.agent.line: Say what the hook should do. A chat with the hooks editor writes it, and asks you before saving.
how.self.line: Choose the event and the command in the hook editor.
how.agent.noScope: The Agent can save hooks for this realm or this folder (shared), and you can change neither here. Choose Write it yourself.
ask.title: Write a hook with the Agent
ask.body: A chat on {{computer}} writes the hook and shows it to you before saving. It then appears in this list.
ask.localNote: The Agent can't save hooks in This folder (just me). For those, choose Write it yourself.
ask.exactLine: This is the chat's complete first message, word for word.
ask.empty: Say what the hook should do.
start.unavailable: Can't start a chat on {{computer}} right now.
start.waiting: Starting the chat on {{computer}} once the agent panel's last message has settled.
start.unknown: This chat may have been started on {{computer}}. Check again reads what happened; it never starts the chat again. Stop tracking frees Start, and starting again may start a second chat.
start.unknownNoText: Its message is not kept on this page.
start.untracked: If the chat was started, it shows in your chats.
start.unlinked: The chat was started. Open it from your chats.
